extracted.name: Bananerberry Smoothie
extracted.description: Strawberries, bananas, peaches, and apples blended with vanilla ice cream for a delightful fruit smoothie.
instruction_lines: In a blender combine strawberries, banana, peaches, apples, and ice cream. Blend until smooth. Add ice, pour in milk and blend again until smooth. Serve immediately.
